items.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
items.summary: The Ukrainian president says the slowed-down internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

items.title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
items.summary: Han Won-seok, 34, confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to get a near-perfect mark on the significant test.

items.title: Pope Leo rides in helicopter cockpit during Peru trip
items.summary: The Pope took to the skies before arriving in Cusco on the penultimate day of his Latin America tour.

items.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
items.summary: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.

items.title: Czechs rally against plan to switch funding of public media
items.summary: Protesters say the move will stifle media freedom, while the government insists broadcasters need to cut costs.

items.title: Police ban protests near 10 schools and five universities in Paris
items.summary: The order will be in place from 16 to 20 November, Paris police chief Patrice Faure says.
